screen.signInTitle: Sign in to scan your grocery list
screen.signInBody: We add the items straight to your basket, so we need to know whose basket it is.

cta.takePhoto: Take a photo and we will build the basket for you.

picker.title: Turn your grocery list into a basket
picker.body: Take a photo of your list, or upload one. We will find each item in the shop and show you what we found before anything is added.
picker.hint: Handwritten or printed, in English or Urdu. JPG, PNG or WEBP.
picker.takeAria: Take a photo of your grocery list
picker.uploadAria: Upload an image of your grocery list
picker.rejectType: Please choose a photo — a JPG, PNG or WEBP image.
picker.rejectSize: That photo is larger than {mb} MB. Try taking it again at a smaller size.

preview.title: Does this look right?
preview.body: Make sure the whole list is visible and the writing is readable.
preview.alt: The grocery list you are about to scan

progress.takes: This usually takes a few seconds. Please keep this page open.

review.title: We found your groceries
review.chooseProduct: Choose a product for the items above, or scan a different list.
review.finalPrices: Final prices are confirmed when the items reach your basket.
review.warningGeneric: Some of your list may not have been read correctly. Please check each item.
review.warningFirstN: Only the first {n} items on the list were read.

card.ambiguous: We’re not sure which product you mean.
card.noticeOutOfStock: This is out of stock right now, so it will not be added.
card.noticeCapped_one: You asked for {asked}, but only {available} is available.
card.noticeCapped_other: You asked for {asked}, but only {available} are available.
card.noticeQuantityAdjusted: We could not read the quantity clearly, so we set it to {quantity}.

sheet.title: Which one did you mean?
sheet.none: We don’t have anything matching this in the shop.

outcome.failNotFound: This product is no longer in our catalogue

failure.offlineMessage: We could not reach FreshCarts to read your list.
failure.offlineS1: Check your mobile data or Wi-Fi
failure.unreadableTitle: The image is difficult to read
failure.unreadableMessage: We could not make out the writing on that photo.
failure.unreadableS1: Try taking a clearer photo in good light
failure.unreadableS2: Hold the camera steady and fill the frame with the list
failure.unreadableS3: Flatten the paper so the whole list is in focus
failure.tooLargeMessage: Please use a smaller photo of your list.
failure.tooLargeS1: Take the photo again at a lower resolution
failure.tooLargeS2: Crop it to just the list
failure.invalidTitle: That file is not a photo
failure.invalidMessage: We can read JPG, PNG and WEBP images.
failure.invalidS1: Choose a photo from your gallery
failure.invalidS2: Take a new photo of your list
failure.unavailableTitle: We could not read your list right now
failure.unavailableMessage: Scanning is temporarily unavailable. Everything else still works.
failure.unavailableS1: Try again in a few minutes
failure.searchSuggestion: Add your items by searching instead
failure.genericMessage: We could not process that photo. Please try again.
failure.emptyTitle: We couldn’t find any grocery items in this image
failure.emptyMessage: The photo was readable, but nothing on it looked like a shopping list.
failure.emptyS1: Make sure the list itself is in the photo
failure.emptyS2: Try a clearer photo with the writing facing up
failure.emptyS3: One item per line reads best
